title: Partner insights contract
description: Language-neutral partner-insights shapes shared by iOS, Android, backend, and admin. PRIVACY-CRITICAL: insight events store only a partner-scoped SHA-256 user hash (raw UIDs never appear, cross-partner correlation impossible); anonymous_pass_by contributions require the partnerInsightsPassBy feature flag (default OFF) plus the user's explicit anonymousPartnerStatsOptIn, and a non-opted-in contribution is silently not recorded; aggregates for anonymous_pass_by below the minimum-unique-contributor threshold (floor 10 — configuration can only raise it) are ZEROED with status insufficient_data; raw events expire after 7 days and only threshold-enforced aggregates persist. Neither collection is ever client-readable. Firestore stores timestamps as native Timestamp values; this contract describes their ISO 8601 JSON serialization.

insightResultStatus.description: insufficient_data means the pass-by contributor threshold was not met — counts are zeroed, never exposed.

partnerInsightsEvent.description: Firestore `partnerInsightsEvents/{eventId}` — raw event, backend-only, 7-day TTL. Document ID = {companyId}_{type}_{utcDay}_{scopedHash} (per-day dedupe).

userReferenceHash.description: SHA-256('kcc-pi:{companyId}:{uid}') — partner-scoped; the raw UID is never stored.

expiresAt.description: occurredAt + 7 days; enforced by the partnerInsights-cleanupExpired scheduled function.

partnerInsightsAggregate.description: Firestore `partnerInsights/{aggregateId}` — threshold-enforced aggregate, backend-only. Document ID = {companyId}_{type}_{periodType}_{periodStart}. Written by the partnerInsights-aggregateDaily scheduled function (idempotent overwrite).

uniqueContributorCount.description: Null when zeroed by the threshold or when no data.

recordInteractionRequest.description: Input for partnerInsights.recordInteraction (any active user). relatedOfferId must belong to the same partner.

recordInteractionResponse.description: recorded=false covers BOTH the per-day dedupe and a non-opted-in pass-by contribution — deliberately indistinguishable so opting out is unobservable.

driveHeatCell.description: One anonymised drive-heat cell — the ONLY per-cell shape that leaves the backend. No user ids, routes, endpoints or timestamps. contributorCount is always >= 10 (the unique-contributor floor); cells below it are omitted entirely, never zeroed-and-shown.

h3Index.description: H3 cell index at resolution 10 (~150 m across).

contributorCount.description: Distinct consented users who drove this cell (>= the privacy floor).

weight.description: Total drive-traversals of this cell (density signal; carries no identity).

driveHeatResponse.description: Raw payload of the partnerInsights.driveHeat admin callable (no { ok, data } envelope). The anonymised H3 drive heatmap: consented users' completed drives over a rolling window, endpoints trimmed, binned to H3 cells and floored at >= 10 unique contributors per hex.

resolution.description: H3 resolution the cells are binned at (10), so the client renders boundaries to match.

windowDays.description: Rolling window (days) of completed drives folded into the aggregate.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 build time of the aggregate, or null if it has never run.
